notes.title: Localization Update
notes.content:
Greetings from the bottom of the ocean, 

we have a little update for you, with which we want to spread the word of a [i]sunken city[/i] to the farthest corners of the world. 
The Game (and therefore the Demo) is now available in 8 different languages!

[list]
[*]English
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]Spanish
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Japanese
[*]Russian
[/list]

We are super proud of this achivement as a small team and can't wait for all the different people around the world to try our game.

If you spot any mistakes please do not hesitate to contact us here in the steam forum or on our [url=https://discord.gg/V6Ctp3qCGz]Discord[/url].


Thanks again for your support and see you around in Atlantis!

notes.title: New Demo Update! x Games made in Germany Steam Event
notes.content:
[h1]NEW DEMO OUT NOW![/h1]

We are proud to finally show you all our new demo with the new core feature we've been working on for the last couple of months. And what better timing could we choose than a Steam Event celebrating Awesome Games made in Germany?
